What do I bring to rehab?

items: ID , insurance card, debit card (personal purchases)
Clothes for 7-14 days (laundry services available on site)
Toothbrush, toothpaste, deodorant, wash cloth, body wash,

blocks.html: shampoo/conditioner (check items for alcohol content, if there are items with alcohol content please leave them at home ie; Mouthwash,certain perfumes)
blocks.text: shampoo/conditioner (check items for alcohol content, if there are items with alcohol content please leave them at home ie; Mouthwash,certain perfumes)

items: We provide meals throughout the day however if someone has a specialty food item please ensure this item is fully sealed upon arrival to the facility
Unopened Tobacco products for your stay (Vape,Cigarettes, Chew) *We can also order these items at the facility at the patients expense*

blocks.text: Are my family members or friends allowed to visit?

blocks.html: Family visitation is not allowed for the first seven days of treatment, but then may be allowed with the approval of the Clinical Director.
